charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.templa: Library entries are complete template snapshots. Merge or replace updates matching template IDs and keeps the others; template camera IDs are assigned when loading, not matched by name during import. A full restore replaces the library only if this file contains it. Older readers may ignore the library block: use a version with library support to restore templates.

charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.diagno: Diagnostics may contain world/user names, IDs, file paths and saved or draft configuration. Review the downloaded file before sharing; no camera feed or audio is included.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.profil: These are saved world configurations, not the pending draft. Opening another scene keeps the edit context bound to that scene. To apply, view that scene first. Duplication loads a draft; it does not write immediately.
This composition references missing users. Resolve or exclude them using selective copying before duplicating.

charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.duplic: Review duplication: replaces complete camera layouts for users in the source, keeps other destination users and scene properties, copies positioning control, excludes the camera background. Pending edits will be discarded only after confirmation. Apply in the destination scene to publish.

charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.frameB: Blend the complete frame with the content behind it. This is separate from the tint color layer. Selection previews locally and is one Undo step; Apply shares it. The asset, visibility, tint and video geometry stay unchanged.
Keep the previous path-based behavior: paths containing /frame use Screen; other paths use Normal.
Use the artwork's original colors and transparency. Recommended for illustrated frames and portraits.
Lighten the background: black areas contribute no light. This is not a replacement for an alpha channel.
Blend light and shadow gently with the background; the result depends on what is behind the frame.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.frameP: Load into the draft with local preview. Replaces frame bounds, fitting and alignment; resets its offset, scale and rotation. Keeps the asset, visibility, opacity and tint. Undo restores the previous settings.
No extension. Show the complete image within the camera.
Extend 10% on each side; percentages use the camera width or height.
Extend 25% below the camera; the camera itself stays the same size.
Schematic: solid, hatched rectangle = camera; dashed rectangle = frame bounds. These diagrams do not show the asset or its transparency. The dock reserves space for the final transformed frame.

Choose a transparent asset with a suitable opening for the video. These presets do not generate artwork or automatically align its opening. Disabled frames stay disabled: enable the frame to see it, then adjust the fit and extensions if necessary.

charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.title: Camera editor
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.shared: Preview is local. Applied changes are shared with everyone.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.sceneR: Open a scene to edit cameras. Backups remain available in Tools.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.sceneC: Editing is bound to a different scene. Return there before applying.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.sceneD: This scene no longer exists. The draft cannot be saved.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.userDe: This camera's user no longer exists.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.permis: Only a GM can apply shared changes.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.confli: Resolve conflicting external changes before applying.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.contro: Switching control preserves saved geometry. Charlemos positions undocked cameras only.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.name: Name
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.dockHe: Docked cameras keep Foundry positioning. Undock explicitly to position them with Charlemos. Percentages refer to the containing block; vw/vh refer to the window.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.resetS: Reset this section in the draft
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.backup: Download a backup before replacing configurations.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.saveFa: Saving failed. Review the current state before retrying.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.recove: Saving failed and could not be fully restored. External changes were preserved. Download a backup and inspect diagnostics.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.busy: An operation is already in progress.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.backup: Backup downloaded. It contains saved settings, not pending changes.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.resolv: Apply or discard pending edits before importing.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.invali: This is not a supported Charlemos configuration file.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.unknow: Some scenes or users are missing. Assign or exclude their entries before importing.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.restor: Replace all saved Charlemos configuration with this complete backup? This may remove existing settings.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.export: Export the pending draft? Choose Cancel to export saved settings instead.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.missin: An enabled frame requires an image or video.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.duplic: Choose distinct destinations and at least one camera.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.missin: An included camera depends on an excluded camera. Include its target or exclude it too.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.preset: Loads geometry into the draft, preserving frames and effects. Responsive units adapt to each viewer's window; pixels remain fixed. Charlemos positioning requires undocked cameras.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.accept: Load this distribution without the cameras listed as excluded? Their existing settings will remain unchanged.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.copyHe: Copies enter the draft. Scene copies preserve user IDs and do not change the live scene background. Geometry is excluded by default.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.copyRe: Copy these categories into the destination draft?
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.conver: Convert to absolute positioning, keeping the visible rectangle
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.undock: Undocking changes Foundry's camera window immediately. Canceling the draft does not dock it again.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.conver: This element has complex CSS. Convert its values explicitly before dragging.

charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.unavai: Resource unavailable locally; check the path and permissions
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.bounds: Extensions are percentages of camera width or height. Transparency defines the silhouette; the dock reserves the transformed rectangle.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.copyBa: Include live background when copying the whole scene
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.import: Load old global layouts into the draft
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.recove: Saving failed. Previous values were restored; the draft remains available.
charlemos-camera-layout.ui.editor.incomp: Full restoration requires all three configuration blocks.
